pages.title: Plagg Eating Camembert Cheese Beside Adrien's Cat Miraculous Ring Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Plagg eating Camembert cheese beside Adrien's Cat Miraculous ring, sitting near a large cheese wheel while Adrien watches with his chin supported. Plagg holds a small wedge in both paws. The ring's paw emblem, cheese rind, and shirt folds add detailed sections.

pages.title: Trixx, Wayzz, and Pollen Floating Together Above Their Miraculous Jewels Coloring Page
pages.description: Trixx, Wayzz, and Pollen float above their Miraculous jewels in this printable coloring page, spreading their small limbs among curling trails and pointed sparkles around them. A fox-tail pendant, turtle-shell jewel, and bee ornament appear below. Large kwami shapes contrast with fine shell panels, wings, and antennae.

pages.title: Master Fu Opening the Chinese Miracle Box with Wayzz Beside Him Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Master Fu opening the Chinese Miracle Box with Wayzz beside him, lifting its round lid above a ring of decorated compartments. His floral shirt and small round glasses add recognizable details. The box's central symbol, jewel emblems, and Wayzz's shell supply smaller sections.

pages.title: Aquabug and Aqua Noir Swimming Through the Flooded Streets of Paris Coloring Page
pages.description: Aquabug and Aqua Noir swim through flooded Paris streets in this printable coloring page, moving side by side with fin-shaped costume details and bubbles rising around them. Rows of submerged buildings frame the pair. Costume spots, flowing hair, gill-like panels, and distant window rows create varied coloring areas.

pages.title: Lady Ice and Ice Cat Skating Through Frozen Paris Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lady Ice and Ice Cat skating through frozen Paris, leaning forward with bent arms above curved blade tracks on the ice. Pointed crystalline shapes decorate their suits and boots. Hair sections, skate laces, and distant tower latticework add smaller details around the moving pair.

pages.title: Cosmobug and Astrocat Flying Above Earth with Their Space Wings Coloring Page
pages.description: Cosmobug and Astrocat fly above Earth with space wings in this printable coloring page, reaching forward in armored suits over the planet's broad curved horizon below. Segmented wing panels spread behind their shoulders. Stars, circular emblems, costume spots, and outlined continents provide varied sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Lady Noire and Mister Bug Facing the Giant Reflekdoll Robot Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Lady Noire and Mister Bug facing the giant Reflekdoll robot, holding a staff and yo-yo beneath its reaching jointed hands above them. Lady Noire's braid trails over one shoulder. Reflekdoll's round head shapes and Mister Bug's costume spots create repeated circular coloring sections.

pages.title: Multimouse Using Multitude to Create a Group of Tiny Copies Coloring Page
pages.description: Multimouse uses Multitude to create tiny copies in this printable coloring page, standing centrally with four smaller versions arranged around her on different rooftop levels nearby. Each figure has round mouse ears and a thin tail. Broad costume panels contrast with the small masks, oval patches, and curled tail tips.

pages.title: Dragon Bug Holding Her Sword and Yo-yo in Her Dragon-themed Suit Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dragon Bug holding her sword and yo-yo in a dragon-themed suit, standing above Paris rooftops with pointed ornaments beside her ponytails. Leaflike scales decorate her torso and boots. Circular spots, the sword's elaborate guard, and distant tower latticework add smaller sections to color.

pages.title: Pegabug Stepping Through a Horseshoe-shaped Portal Above Paris Coloring Page
pages.description: Pegabug steps through a horseshoe-shaped portal above Paris in this printable coloring page, lifting one leg beside a tall opening edged with circles and swirling ribbons. A high ponytail follows her movement. Costume spots, horseshoe emblems, sparkles, and detailed rooftops provide smaller sections around the broad portal.

pages.title: Bug Noire Confronting Monarch in Her Combined Ladybug and Cat Costume Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Bug Noire confronting Monarch in her combined Ladybug and cat costume, standing with clenched fists opposite his tall masked figure above Paris. Two long braids frame her spotted suit. Monarch's wing shapes, pointed coat panels, and the distant skyline add contrasting coloring details.

pages.title: Shadybug and Claw Noir Standing Together on a Paris Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadybug and Claw Noir stand together on a Paris rooftop in this printable coloring page, posing with hands on hips and a staff resting across one shoulder. High ponytails and cat ears distinguish the pair. Costume spots, boot cuffs, chimney pots, and tower latticework provide smaller sections to color.

pages.title: Hawk Moth Releasing an Akuma Butterfly From His Butterfly-filled Lair Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hawk Moth releasing an akuma butterfly from his butterfly-filled lair, extending one palm while his other hand rests on a cane. A large circular window fills the wall behind him. Butterfly wings, pointed coat panels, and concentric floor steps form contrasting coloring sections.

pages.title: Mayura Holding Her Feather Fan with Duusu Floating Beside Her Coloring Page
pages.description: Mayura holds her feather fan with Duusu floating beside her in this printable coloring page, standing beneath an arch in a long, layered peacock-inspired costume and headpiece. Eye-shaped motifs repeat across the fan and skirt. Duusu's small tail feathers and the narrow costume sections add finer coloring detail.

pages.title: Cat Blanc Standing Before the Broken Eiffel Tower in Flooded Paris Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Cat Blanc standing before the broken Eiffel Tower in flooded Paris, clenching his fists on a rooftop above partly submerged buildings. The tower's detached upper section hangs over its damaged frame. Water ripples, roof windows, and pointed boot cuffs provide smaller coloring sections.

pages.title: Ladybug and Rena Rouge Facing the Mischievous Sapotis Monsters Coloring Page
pages.description: Ladybug and Rena Rouge face the mischievous Sapotis monsters in this printable coloring page, standing ready with yo-yo and flute opposite two horned creatures on a terrace. The creatures have pointed ears and leaflike collars. Costume spots, floor tiles, railings, and distant tower latticework add smaller sections.

pages.title: Ladybug and Cat Noir Escaping Queen Wasp and Her Swarm of Wasps Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ladybug and Cat Noir escaping Queen Wasp and her swarm, running over Paris rooftops as the winged villain hovers above them. Three large wasps surround her pointed costume. Veined wings, segmented insect bodies, chimney stacks, and costume details provide varied areas to color.

pages.title: Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, Queen Bee, and Carapace Assembled as a Superhero Team Coloring Page
pages.description: Ladybug, Cat Noir, Rena Rouge, Queen Bee, and Carapace assemble as a superhero team in this printable coloring page, posing on stepped rooftops above the Paris skyline. Staff, flute, yo-yo, and shield distinguish the group. Costume spots, zigzag bands, shield panels, and flowing hair provide varied coloring sections.

pages.title: Ladybug and Cat Noir Facing Mr. Pigeon and His Flock in a Paris Square Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Ladybug and Cat Noir facing Mr. Pigeon and his flock in a Paris square, standing before a fountain as birds fly overhead. Mr. Pigeon's layered feather costume fills the center. Water arcs, pavement tiles, broad wings, and the heroes' accessories offer contrasting sections.
